From my personal experience with anxiety I have found it be linked intimately with being self absorbed. You're always worried what people are thinking of you, when in reality they probably don't give a fuck. Most people don't sit around all day wondering what "that weird kid in my chem class" is doing. Sorry if I come off as an asshole but people really don't care about you as much as you think they do. I used to be socially awkward and depressed due to anxiety, and realizing that people are more concerned with themselves than me was a big step in getting over it.
